title: Discover Findie
description: A full animated explainer film for Findie's 'Descubrimiento' product — an independent film discovery platform connecting audiences with curated arthouse and documentary cinema from Latin America and beyond.
challenge: Findie needed to explain a nuanced cultural proposition — independent film discovery — to an audience that was unfamiliar with their platform. Generic SaaS-style explainers were off-brand for a company rooted in cinema aesthetics.
solution: Created a hand-crafted animation style inspired by vintage film aesthetics: textured backgrounds, film grain overlays, and a color palette drawn from 70s cinema. Every frame was designed to feel like a still from the films Findie celebrates.
result: The film drove a 28% increase in new sign-ups during its launch campaign period and was featured in Findie's press kit for regional media coverage.
